remarks: Located in the highly desirable Heywood Heights complex, welcome to 249 Hamilton Ave #5. This freshly painted two bedroom, 1 full bath, 1 half bath unit features an updated kitchen with cabinetry, granite countertops and new stainless steel appliances, a generous dining area, large living room with new carpet and sliders to a generous private deck. Stackable washer/dryer in-unit and plenty of closet storage, also a private storage in basement. Complex boasts swimming pool and plenty of parking. Truly a great one-level living experience! Excellent credit a must, no exceptions.
